text: {"lessons":["My early sales of winning Stock A and D felt rewarding, but I should avoid taking profits merely to lock them in; exits should follow my thesis and risk limits.","Selling Stock C and E below cost was painful, yet the loss alone should not decide whether I hold or sell; I should reassess each position objectively.","After mostly holding through declines and making only a few later purchases, I still lack evidence of a repeatable edge; I should avoid reacting to monthly swings and make measured, diversified decisions."]}
